titleEn: I'm Your Big Sister. I'll Hug You!

pages.text: "Mom, look at me!" Pongi hopped in front of the sofa by the window. Mom, wearing her headscarf, sat with Pongi's brother on her lap and patted his back. "Shh. He's sleeping. Be quiet." Pongi pouted.
"I don't like my brother! Hug me too!" Pongi stamped her feet. Mom kept patting him and only turned her head a little. Pongi pulled the blanket over herself and hid in the sofa corner.
Under the blanket it was dark as night, with one thin bright gap. Outside were her brother's giggles and Mom's laughter. Alone, Pongi said softly, "I'm here too..." Her mouth drooped.

Mom lifted the blanket halfway. "You're a big sister, Pongi. There are things only a big sister can do." She held Pongi's paws tight. "When your brother cries, you can hug him. Shall we try together?"
They were by the blanket at the end of the sofa. Mom put a paw on Pongi's back. Her brother was crying. Pongi looked quietly. "Why is he crying? Oh... his shell fell on the floor!"

Pongi carefully picked up the shell and put it in her brother's paws. His crying stopped, and his mouth opened in a big smile. A little paw held Pongi's paw tight. Her unhappy feelings slowly disappeared.
Pongi opened both paws and hugged her brother very gently. "Mom! I made him stop crying!" She thumped her tail. Pongi called, "I'm your big sister. I'll hug you!"
Being a big sister was fun now. Pongi leaned out to the side. "Peekaboo!" Her brother lifted both feet and laughed. Pongi giggled. "Having a little brother isn't so bad!"
When Mom patted her brother, Pongi sang a soft lullaby beside them. "One, hug him when he cries! Two, pick up his shell when it falls! Three, tiptoe when he sleeps!" His eyes slowly closed.

On the sofa, Mom gave them both a snug hug, one on each knee. "You're a real big sister now, Pongi!" A little brother brings things only a big sister can do. Pongi said, "I'm your big sister. I'll hug you!"
